paragraphs: Birmingham City University (BCU) is a post-1992 modern public university in central Birmingham, UK. With over 31,000 students, BCU is a leader in creative industries (Birmingham School of Art + Royal Birmingham Conservatoire), business, engineering, and health. Distinct from the older Russell-Group University of Birmingham.

International students enter via Birmingham City University International College (BCUIC) — Navitas's pathway college on the BCU City Centre Campus. Foundation and Pre-Master programs lead into a BCU Bachelor's or Master's degree across all major faculties.
paragraphsRu: Birmingham City University (BCU) — современный государственный post-1992 университет в центре Бирмингема. Более 31 000 студентов. Лидер в creative industries (Birmingham School of Art + Royal Birmingham Conservatoire), бизнесе, инженерии и health. Отличается от старого Russell Group University of Birmingham.

Международные студенты заходят через Birmingham City University International College (BCUIC) — pathway-колледж Navitas на BCU City Centre Campus. Foundation и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру BCU.
